category_title: Seventh-grade students in an urban classroom exhibiting frequent off-task behavior
scenario_title: Social Studies Map Activity and Independent Work
minimal_context: The student is seated at a table with peers in a social studies class, working on a map activity with their journal open.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your journals, make sure your pencils are sharpened, and begin working independently on your map activity at your tables.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: See? My notebook is out, too. Am I doing a good job on my map?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: We need to go back to how she was doing class. You aren't saying anything when we do it right.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Don't worry about that right now, and don't talk to your neighbors. Just stay in your seat and finish the map.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from the table and stops working on the map) I'm not doing this. (Walks over to another group to start a nonacademic conversation and begins eating a snack)
